sourceDocuments.text: Postcolonial disillusionment in the poetry of Niyi Osundare manifests through ecological degradation imagery in the oil-producing Niger Delta creeks, where petroleum spills poison agrarian livelihoods.

studentDocument.title: Environmental Activism in Contemporary Nigerian Verse
studentDocument.text: Nigerian poets increasingly engage with the extractive destruction of the environment. Postcolonial disillusionment in the poetry of Niyi Osundare manifests through ecological degradation imagery in the oil-producing Niger Delta creeks, where petroleum spills poison agrarian livelihoods. The verse becomes a site of civic contestation against multinational corporate impunity.
